title: Apple Privacy Manifest (PrivacyInfo.xcprivacy)
description: Schema for validating PrivacyInfo.xcprivacy after plistlib decoding into a Python dict. Apple does NOT publish a formal JSON Schema for this file; this schema is derived from Apple's published structural documentation (see x-source) and is reviewed quarterly per ADR 0001.
x-spec-version: Apple privacy manifest spec as documented at the URL above on the captured-on date. Apple has expanded this spec twice in 2024; treat as time-versioned data, not stable.
x-update-policy: When Apple changes the spec: (1) refetch the four pages under bundleresources/app-privacy-configuration; (2) diff against this schema; (3) update enums/structure as needed; (4) bump x-captured-on; (5) add a fixture under converter/compliance/tests/fixtures/ that exercises the new shape; (6) re-run the privacy-manifest test suite.

NSPrivacyTracking.description: Whether the app or third-party SDK uses data for tracking as defined under the App Tracking Transparency framework. If true, NSPrivacyTrackingDomains must list every internet domain used for tracking purposes.

NSPrivacyTrackingDomains.description: Internet domains that the app or third-party SDK connects to and uses for tracking. Required to be non-empty when NSPrivacyTracking is true. Each entry is a fully-qualified domain (no scheme, no path).

NSPrivacyCollectedDataTypes.description: Types of data the app or third-party SDK collects, with the purposes for collection and any links to the user's identity / use for tracking.

NSPrivacyAccessedAPITypes.description: Required-reason API categories the app or third-party SDK uses, with the approved Apple reason codes for each.

allOf.description: If NSPrivacyTracking is true, at least one tracking domain must be declared.

NSPrivacyAccessedAPITypeReasons.description: Approved Apple reason codes for this category. Must contain at least one entry; entries must be valid for the named category.

allOf.description: FileTimestamp category: only DDA9.1 / C617.1 / 3B52.1 / 0A2A.1 are valid.
DiskSpace category: only 85F4.1 / E174.1 / 7D9E.1 / B728.1 are valid.
UserDefaults category: only CA92.1 / 1C8F.1 / C56D.1 / AC6B.1 are valid.

NSPrivacyCollectedDataType.description: Apple-defined data-type identifier (e.g. NSPrivacyCollectedDataTypeName, NSPrivacyCollectedDataTypeEmailAddress, NSPrivacyCollectedDataTypeDeviceID, …). Full list at developer.apple.com/documentation/bundleresources/app-privacy-configuration/nsprivacycollecteddatatypes/nsprivacycollecteddatatype.

NSPrivacyCollectedDataTypeLinked.description: Whether the collected data is linked to the user's identity.

NSPrivacyCollectedDataTypeTracking.description: Whether the collected data is used for tracking as defined by App Tracking Transparency. If true, NSPrivacyTracking must also be true.
